title: Tarn 0.8 release notes
text:
Tarn 0.8 release notes

Tarn is a small local inference server for language models. Version 0.8 added a command line flag for the context length and fixed a crash when two clients opened a stream at the same moment. The server reserves its whole context memory at start, and it still does so in this release. Tokens are streamed as they are produced. Logging moved to standard error.

title: Tarn 0.9 release notes
text:
Tarn 0.9 release notes

The headline change of Tarn 0.9 is the paged KV cache. Context memory is now handed out in pages of 256 tokens as a request grows, so an idle server holds almost nothing. On the reference laptop the default context memory fell by 40 percent. The page size is fixed at build time. Version 0.9 also made the model loader skip tensors it does not use.

title: Tarn 1.0 release notes
text:
Tarn 1.0 release notes

Tarn 1.0 freezes the wire format of the chat endpoint. The grammar sampler gained a depth limit, and requests that exceed it are refused with a clear error. The paged cache from earlier releases is unchanged. The project now promises that a minor release never removes a flag.

title: Tarn server guide
text:
Tarn server guide

Start the server with the serve command. By default the server listens on port 7421 and binds to the loopback address only, so nothing outside the machine can reach it. Use the bind flag to listen on another address. The health endpoint answers with the word ready once the model is loaded.

title: Kestrel: sparse routing for small language models
text:
Kestrel: sparse routing for small language models

We present Kestrel, a routing layer that sends each token to two of sixteen small expert blocks instead of through one large feed-forward block. Training Kestrel needs no extra loss term beyond a load-balance penalty. At equal compute, Kestrel lowers validation perplexity by 8 percent against a dense baseline. The gain vanishes when fewer than eight experts are used, which suggests that expert count matters more than expert size.

title: Mossgrid changelog
text:
Mossgrid changelog

Mossgrid is a grid layout library for terminals. Release 2.3 adds a resize event and fixes a bug where wide characters shifted the columns. Nothing in this library depends on a server, a cache or a model.
